spec_match.rationale: Exercises the real toBase64()/fromBase64() pair on the exact prototype/static surfaces (support now probes BOTH members before taking the native path), with TextEncoder/TextDecoder round-trip and live byte views.

interactive.rationale: Live pipeline updates on every keystroke and three sample buttons; verified 59-byte emoji sample round-trips and byte counts update.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the five-step pipeline with intermediate bytes; page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: UTF-8/emoji/control-byte inputs covered, but fromBase64's SyntaxError path (invalid base64) is never exercisable since the page only decodes strings it just encoded.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus link present (added 2026-08-30 — the see-also previously lacked the mandatory link).

conformance.rationale: Feature suite pins existence, round-trip and the throws-on-bad-input contract; all 7 assertions pass live in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: No showcaseTelemetry.assert calls; the round-trip verdict exists only in the DOM.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; after review the supported-state status text is charcoal on stone (12+:1) instead of emerald (~3.7:1); ctrl-btn sets background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Textarea and buttons are labelled native controls, but the round-trip status bar is not a live region, so its ok/error flips are visual-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; pipeline is a single column that reflows cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Let visitors feed fromBase64() invalid input
openQuestions.detail: The decode stage only ever receives freshly-encoded valid base64, so the SyntaxError contract (which the conformance suite pins) has no interactive surface. A small 'edit the base64 before decoding' affordance would demonstrate the error path honestly.

openQuestions.title: Make the status bar a live region and add telemetry asserts
openQuestions.detail: aria-live=polite on #status-bar plus showcaseTelemetry.assert('b64-round-trip', match) would announce results non-visually and feed production telemetry.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens, adequate touch targets, visible focus, honest capability handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages already use CSS variables throughout; verified zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 for all six concepts; fixes kept the existing token-based styling.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 on all 6 concepts, both classes

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region labelled form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; surface state changes as text; keep native elements for keyboard support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Existing labels/aria-labels verified; remaining gaps (status bars not aria-live, hex cells click-only) recorded as open questions rather than silently passed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: page source review + CDP interaction transcript 2026-08-30

summary: Verified end-to-end on a browser that really has the API: all three samples plus typed input round-trip, byte/char counts update, console clean. Copy fixed 2026-08-30: mandatory ChromeStatus link added to see-also. [review follow-up 2026-08-30 #3] Codex: support probe extended to require fromBase64 as well as toBase64; supported-state status colour brought to AA.
